verdict: A near-faithful rebuild where every block, icon and string is in place and colors match; the residual gaps are sub-pixel drifts (image crop, card, badges, a wider tab indicator, a bigger EN label), and the structure is well named with auto-layout and instanced nav items but no styles or variables and fractional magic spacings.

top_defects.where: Featured article card image and summary card
top_defects.what: badge photo scaled/cropped slightly differently and card edges 1-2 px off: the heatmap's hottest band (grid row 3, meanDiff up to 27) is the whole image outlined, not a missing element
no text styles, color styles or variables (styled 0) and fractional hand-measured gaps (36.2, 24.4, 4.3, 8.35, 12.2) instead of consistent spacing tokens
items are instances but the file holds no local components (components 0), so the repeated nav item and tab cannot be edited from one main component here
38 absolute layers; image, scrim, actions and summary stacked absolutely inside an auto-layout card, and the status bar placed after Content in the layer order
"EN" set at 12 px 500, visibly larger and heavier than the reference's label inside the #4d4d4e box
red "new" dots offset by ~2-4 px (Saved dot lower/left of the reference's)
every nav item carries a Badge ellipse, including Home, Search and More where none shows (hidden leftovers)

strengths: All content present and exact, including the truncated extract, date line and red hint dots
Correct app icons (wordmark, bookmark, share, home-filled, activity) as real vectors with the reference colors #3366cc, #72777d, #e8f0ff, #eaecf0
Clear, readable layer names (Header, Tabs bar, Language button, Featured article card, Nav item – Home…) with auto-layout on bars and rows
